messages.subject: Re: Rank regression with sem
parts:
how can I do this in one-step by using sem? 

You can't.  By your own description, you want to analyze a transformation of "data" (factor scores) that are estimates based on an analysis of the untransformed data. I can only suppose you want to avoid certain assumptions by analyzing ranks, but the factor score estimates you want to transform are still going to be based on those assumptions.  But if you do this, I imagine your best bet would be a plausible values approach.  See the ?plausibleValues help page in the semTools package, and find References therein.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
